{{Quote|Today I asked Noah Tsuga, the expedition's lead explorer, to accompany me to the burial chambers. Impressed by what he witnessed; he too is a believer of the superstitions that have been echoing throughout the camp in the days since we first penetrated the walls of the catacombs.|Page 5 of [[Lost Diary of Walter Emanus|Walter Emanus' lost journal]]|<ref name="SWG:WELJ" />}}
'''Noah Tsuga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] lead [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was part of the archeological expedition that accompanied [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Walter Emanus]] in the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Tsuga and most of the team eventually fall under the influence of the dark spirit of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].<ref name="SWG:WELJ" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Noah Tsuga was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WELJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Noah Tsuga was mentioned in the [[W:c:swg:Walter Emanus' Lost Journal, Page 5|fifth page of Walter Emanus' journal]]. It was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:WELJ" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
